_note: The cruise ship as a walkable place (bd ue6, mandate eatw; the author's direction of 2026-11-02: a side-on cross-section of the ship in the manner of The Life Aquatic, walked from her cabin through the decks and rooms as a vertical slice, each deck or room opening to its own overhead view; the rooms include a disco, the pool deck, a hot tub and a bar). tools/gen_cruise_ship.mjs builds scenes/cruise/ship_section.tscn (the side-view slice: one walk strip per deck, stairs between them, a door per room) and one overhead scene per room with a 'floor' (scenes/cruise/room_<id>.tscn, a door back to the slice at spawn_from_<id>), plus placeholder art in assets/cruise/ until the renders land (prompts/image/cruise/). A room with 'scene' set opens that existing scene instead (the minigames). Decks top to bottom; x is along the ship (bow left), rooms are placed by 'x' on their deck's walk strip. 'size' is the world px of the slice; each deck is 'deck_h' tall.
